1: Beshak Hum ne Nooh (alaihis salaam) ko un ki qaum ki taraf bheja, unhein dawat dete hue taake woh unhein daraa dein is se pehle ke un par un ki Allah ke saath shirk ki haalat ki wajah se dard-naak azaab aa jaaye.
2: Nooh (alaihis salaam) ne apni qaum se kaha: 'Aey meri qaum! Beshak main tumhein Allah ke us azaab se khula darane wala hoon jo tumhara muntazir hai agar tum us ki taraf tauba na karo.'
3: 'Aur mere darane ka khulasa yeh hai: Sirf Allah ki ibadat karo aur us ke saath kisi ko shareek na thehrao; us se daro us ke ahkam baja laa kar aur un cheezon se bach kar jin ki us ne ijazat nahin di, aur us har baat mein meri itaat karo jis ka main tumhein hukm doon.'
4: 'Beshak agar tum aisa karo to Allah tumhare gunah tumhare liye bakhsh dega, un ke siwa jin mein logon ke haqq maare gaye. Woh tumhari qaumon ki umar bhi ek aise waqt tak barha dega jo us ke ilm ke mutabiq muqarrar hai, jahan tum zameen ko abaad karoge jab tak tum us par saabit qadam raho. Beshak jab maut aa jaati hai to woh taali nahin jaati. Agar tum waqai jaanto, to tum Allah par iman laane aur apni shirk aur gumrahi ki haalaton se us ki taraf tauba karne mein jaldi karte.'
5: Nooh (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: 'Aey mere Rubb! Beshak main ne apni qaum ko teri ibadat aur teri wahdaniyat ki taraf bulaya, musalsal, din aur raat.'
6: 'Lekin mere unhein bulane ne un mein door hone ke siwa kuchh na barhaya aur unhein us se door kar diya jis ki taraf main ne unhein bulaya.'
7: 'Aur jab bhi main ne unhein us cheez ki taraf bulaya jis ka matlab un ke gunahon ki bakshish tha, yani sirf teri ibadat, teri aur tere Rasool ki farmanbardari, to unhon ne apni ungliyan apne kaanon mein daal lin taake meri pukar na sun sakein. Unhon ne apne chehre apne kapdon se dhaank bhi liye taake mujhe na dekh sakein, aur woh tere saath apne shirk par qayam rahe, takabbur karte hue ke na meri dawat qabool karein aur na us ke saamne jhukein.'
8: 'Aey mere Rubb! Phir main ne unhein khule-aam bulaya.'
9: 'Main ne unhein apni awaaz buland kar ke bulaya, aur main ne unhein chhup kar dheemi awaaz mein bhi bulaya. Main ne unhein bulane ke mukhtalif tareeqe istemal kiye.'
10: Phir main ne un se kaha: 'Aey meri qaum! Apne Rubb se bakshish maango us ki taraf rujoo kar ke. Beshak woh, woh paak hai, apne bandon mein se jo us ki taraf tauba kare us ke gunah bohat bakshne wala hai.'
11: 'Kyunke agar tum aisa karo to Allah tumhare liye baar baar baarish bhejega, jab bhi tumhein us ki zaroorat ho, pas tum kabhi qehat ka saamna na karoge.'
12: 'Aur woh tumhein maal aur aulaad ki farakhi dega, tumhare liye baagh ugayega jin se tum phal kha sako, aur nehrein bahayega jin se tum piyo aur apni fasalon aur maweshiyon ko paani do.'
13: 'Aey meri qaum! Tumhein kya hua ke tum Allah ki azmat se nahin darte, aisa ke tum bagair kisi parwah ke us ki nafarmani karte ho?!'
14: 'Jab ke us ne tumhein marhalon mein paida kiya, ek ke baad doosra: ek nutfa, phir jama hua khoon, phir gosht ka ek tukda.'
15: 'Kya tum nahin dekhte ke Allah ne saat aasman kaise paida kiye, ek ke oopar doosra?'
16: 'Aur us ne chaand ko zameen walon ke liye ek roshni banaya, sab se qareeb aasman mein, aur sooraj ko bhi chamakta banaya.'
17: 'Aur Allah hi hai jis ne tumhein zameen se paida kiya, tumhare baap Adam (alaihis salaam) ko mitti se paida kar ke. Phir tumhein us se bhi ghiza milti hai jo woh tumhare liye ugati hai.'
18: 'Phir Allah tumhein tumhari maut ke baad us mein lautayega, aur phir tumhein dobara uthne ke liye us se nikal laayega.'
19: 'Aur Allah ne zameen ko tumhare liye phaila bhi diya, tumhare rehne ke liye tayyar.'
20: 'Taake tum us mein kushada raaste banao, halal kamai ki koshish karte hue.'
21: Nooh (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: 'Aey mere Rubb! Beshak meri qaum ne us mein meri nafarmani ki jis ka main ne unhein hukm diya, yani teri wahdaniyat maanna aur sirf teri ibadat karna. Un ke neeche ke logon ne un sardaron ki pairawi ki jinhein tu ne maal aur aulaad se nawaza. Tera unhein nawazna un ki gumrahi hi barha sakta tha.'
22: Un ke bado ne ek badi saazish ki, neeche ke logon ko Nooh (alaihis salaam) ke khilaf ubhar kar.
23: Unhon ne apne pairokaron se kaha: 'Apne maaboodon ki ibadat na chhodo: apne buton Wadd, Suwa, Yaghoos, Yaooq aur Nasr ki ibadat na chhodo.'
24: 'Beshak unhon ne in buton ke zariye bohat se logon ko gumrah kiya. Aey mere Rubb! Un logon ko, jo kufr aur gunahon par ar kar apne aap par zulm karte hain, haqq se mazeed gumrahi ke siwa kuchh na barha.'
25: Un gunahon ki wajah se jo unhon ne kiye, woh duniya mein sailaab se doba diye gaye, aur unhein apni maut ke foran baad Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil kar diya gaya. Unhon ne koi madadgaar na paya jo unhein doobne ya Jahannam ki aag se bachata.
26: Aur jab Allah ne unhein khabar di ke un ki qaum mein se koi kabhi iman na laayega, siwaye un ke jo pehle hi iman laa chuke the, to Nooh (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: 'Aey mere Rubb! Zameen par koi kafir chalta phirta na chhod.'
27: 'Aey mere Rubb! Agar tu unhein chhod de aur unhein mohlat de, to woh tere momin bandon ko gumrah karenge aur sirf aise mazeed hadd se barhne wale paida karenge jo teri farmanbardari na karenge, ya sakht nashukre jo teri niyamaton ka shukr na karenge.'
28: 'Aey mere Rubb! Mere gunah bakhsh de, mere maa-baap ko bakhsh de, aur us ko bakhsh de jo mere ghar mein momin ho kar daakhil ho. Aur momin mardon aur auraton ko bhi bakhsh de, aur un logon ko, jo kufr aur gunahon se apne aap par zulm karte hain, halaakat aur nuqsan ke siwa kuchh na barha.'
